mainScene.inputMethod: Queued synthetic XR controller/HMD states in the normal Dynamic input update; production Input Actions, ray interactors and saved LanguageButton selectEntered handlers. No SelectEnter/SelectExit or TriggerProgrammatically calls. The existing simulator device writer is temporarily disabled.

limitations: Synthetic XR states and XRI manager tests do not prove real headset or physical controller behavior.
The component-restart regression calls MonoBehaviour lifecycle callbacks directly in EditMode.
Monocular captures do not prove stereo or color-vision accessibility, reach, comfort, performance, user-study results or executable build success.
Full main-scene output, logs and Library cache remain local; only useful hotspot evidence is committed.
